STARTING_TILES.name: Entrance Hall
STARTING_TILES.blurb: The front hall where every explorer begins.

STARTING_TILES.name: Foyer
STARTING_TILES.blurb: A dim room connecting the entrance to the rest of the house.

STARTING_TILES.name: Grand Staircase
STARTING_TILES.blurb: A wide staircase leading up into the dark.

LANDING_TILES.name: Upper Landing
LANDING_TILES.blurb: The top of the grand staircase. Stairs lead back down.

LANDING_TILES.name: Basement Landing
LANDING_TILES.blurb: A cramped landing where crooked stairs climb back up.

ROOM_TILES.name: Bedroom
ROOM_TILES.blurb: A canopy bed rots beneath a layer of dust.

ROOM_TILES.name: Attic
ROOM_TILES.blurb: Low beams and shapes hidden under sheets.

ROOM_TILES.name: Crypt
ROOM_TILES.blurb: Stone niches hold what the house would rather forget.

ROOM_TILES.name: Catacombs
ROOM_TILES.blurb: Twisting passages of packed earth and old bone.

ROOM_TILES.name: Furnace Room
ROOM_TILES.blurb: A dead furnace radiates an impossible chill.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Lucky Stone
ITEM_CARDS.text: A smooth, ordinary-looking rock. You sense it will bring you good fortune
ITEM_CARDS.rules: After you attempt a roll of any kind, you can rub the stone once to reroll any number of those dice. Discard this item after you use it

ITEM_CARDS.title: Smelling Salts
ITEM_CARDS.text: Whew, that's a lungful.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: If your or another living explorer's Knowledge is below its starting value, and you're in the same room, you can raise that trait to its starting value by using the Smelling Salts. Discard this item after you use it

ITEM_CARDS.title: Medical Kit
ITEM_CARDS.text: A doctor's bag, depleted in some critical resources
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Once during your turn, you can attempt a Knowledge roll to heal yourself or another explorer in the same room. You can't raise a trait above its starting value with the Medical Kit

bands.text: Heal up to 3 points of physical traits (yours or an explorer's in your room), not above starting values.
Heal up to 2 points of physical traits, not above starting values.
Heal 1 point of a physical trait, not above its starting value.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Angel Feather
ITEM_CARDS.text: A perfect feather fluttering in your hand.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: When you attempt a roll of any kind, you can call out a number from 0 to 8. Use that number instead of rolling the dice. Discard this item after you use it

ITEM_CARDS.title: Healing Salve
ITEM_CARDS.text: A sticky paste in a shallow bowl.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: You can apply the Healing Salve to yourself or to another living explorer in the same room. If that explorer's Might or Speed is below its starting value, raise one or both traits to its starting value. Discard this item after you use it.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Bell
ITEM_CARDS.text: A brass bell that makes a resonant clang.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Gain 1 Sanity now. Lose 1 Sanity if you lose the bell. Once during your turn after the haunt is revealed, you can attempt a Sanity roll to use the bell

bands.text: Move any number of unimpeded heroes 1 space closer to you.
The traitor can move any number of monsters 1 space closer to you (no effect if you are the traitor). With no traitor, all monsters move 1 space closer to you.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Armor
ITEM_CARDS.text: It's just prop armor from a Renaissance fair, but it's still metal
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Any time (not just once per turn) you take physical damage, take 1 less point of damage. This item can't be stolen.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Blood Dagger
ITEM_CARDS.text: A nasty weapon. Needles and tubes extend from the handle and plunge right into your veins
ITEM_CARDS.rules: You roll 3 additional dice (maximum of 8 dice) when making a Might attack with this weapon. If you do, lose 1 Speed. You can't use another weapon while you're using this one. This item can't be traded or dropped. If it's stolen, take 2 dice of physical damage.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Candle
ITEM_CARDS.text: It makes the shadows move--at least, you hope it's doing that.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: If you draw an event card, roll 1 additional die (maximum of 8 dice) for that event's trait rolls. If you have the Bell, Book, and Candle, gain 2 in each trait. The first time you lose one of those 3 items later in the game, lose 2 from each trait.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Idol
ITEM_CARDS.text: Perhaps it's chosen you for some greater purpose. Like human sacrifice.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Once per turn, you can rub the idol before making any trait, combat, or event roll to add 2 dice to the roll (to a maximum of 8 dice). Each time you do, lose 1 Sanity

ITEM_CARDS.title: Rabbit's Foot
ITEM_CARDS.text: Not so lucky for the rabbit.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Once during your turn, you can reroll 1 die. You must keep the second roll.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Dynamite
ITEM_CARDS.text: The fuse isn't lit yet.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Instead of attacking, you can throw the Dynamite through a connecting door into an adjacent room. Each explorer and monster with Might and Speed traits in that room must attempt a Speed roll. Discard this item after you use it

bands.text: Take no damage from the Dynamite.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Amulet of the Ages
ITEM_CARDS.text: Ancient silver and inlaid gems inscribed with blessings.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Gain 1 Might, 1 Speed, 1 Knowledge and 1 Sanity now. Lose 3 Might, 3 Speed, 3 Knowledge and 3 Sanity if you lose the Amulet

ITEM_CARDS.title: Dark Dice
ITEM_CARDS.text: Are you feeling lucky?
ITEM_CARDS.rules: once per turn, you can roll 3 dice:

bands.text: Move to the location of any explorer not revealed as a traitor.
Move one other explorer in your room into an adjacent room.
Immediately move into an adjacent room (no movement cost).
Reduce all your traits to the lowest value above the skull.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Axe
ITEM_CARDS.text: Very Sharp
ITEM_CARDS.rules: You roll 1 additional die (maximum of 8 dice) when making a Might attack with this weapon. You can't use another weapon while you're using this one.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Sacrificial Dagger
ITEM_CARDS.text: A twisted shard of iron covered in mysterious symbols and stained with blood
ITEM_CARDS.rules: When making a Might attack with this weapon, you roll 3 extra dice (maximum of 8 dice), but you must make a Knowledge roll first. You can't use another weapon while you're using this one

bands.text: No effect. Roll 3 extra dice (max 8) on your Might attack.
The dagger twists in your hand! Take 2 dice of physical damage.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Puzzle Box
ITEM_CARDS.text: There must be a way to open it
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Once during your turn, you can attempt a Knowledge roll to open the box:

bands.text: You open the box. Draw 2 item cards.
You just can't get it open.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Revolver
ITEM_CARDS.text: An old, potent-looking weapon
ITEM_CARDS.rules: You can use the Revolver to attack with Speed instead of Might. (Your opponent then defends with Speed and takes physical damage.) With the Revolver, you can attack anyone in the same room or within line of sight (through an uninterrupted straight line of doors). if you attack someone in another room and lose, you don't take damage. You can't use another weapon while you're using this one.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Adrenaline Shot
ITEM_CARDS.text: A syringe containing a strange fluorescent liquid.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Before you attempt a trait roll, you can use this item to add 4 to the result of that roll. Discard this item after you use it.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Pickpocket's Gloves
ITEM_CARDS.text: Helping yourself has never seemed so easy.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: When you are in the same room as another explorer, you can discard this item to take any item that explorer is carrying.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Bottle
ITEM_CARDS.text: An opaque vial containing a black liquid.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Once during your turn after the haunt is revealed, you can roll 3 dice and drink from the Bottle: . Discard this item after you use it

bands.text: Choose a room and put your explorer there.

ITEM_CARDS.title: Music Box
ITEM_CARDS.text: A hand-crafted antique. It plays a haunting melody that gets stuck in your head.
ITEM_CARDS.rules: Once per turn, you can open or close the Music Box. While the Music Box is open, any explorer or monster with a Sanity trait that enters or starts its turn in the same room must make a Sanity roll of 4+. If the roll fails, the explorer or monster ends its turn as it is mesmerized by the music. If an explorer or monster carrying the Music Box is mesmerized, it drops the Music Box. If the Music Box is open when it is dropped, it remains open.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Lights Out
EVENT_CARDS.text: Your flashlight goes out. Don’t worry, someone else has batteries.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Keep this card. You can move only 1 space each turn until you end your turn in the same room as another explorer. At the end of that turn, discard this card. Then you can move normally again. If you have the Candle or end your turn in the Furnace Room, discard this card.

EVENT_CARDS.title: It Is Meant To Be
EVENT_CARDS.text: You collapse to the floor, visions of future events pouring through your head.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Choose one of these 2 options: 
- You can look at the top 3 tiles or cards of any one stack. If you do, rearrange those 3 tiles or cards in any order and put them back on top. Do not tell anyone the results.
- You can choose instead to roll 4 dice and write down the result. For one future die roll of your choice that you attempt, you can use that number instead of rolling. If that number is higher than the maximum possible result, use the maximum possible result instead.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Possession
EVENT_CARDS.text: A shadow separates from the wall. As you stand in shock, the shadow surrounds you and chills you to the core.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
You must choose any one trait and attempt a roll for that trait:
- 4+ You resist the shadow's corruption. Gain 1 in a trait of your choice.
- 0-3 The shadow drains your energy. The chosen trait drops to its lowest value. (it doesn't drop to the skull.) If that trait is already at its lowest value, lower a different trait to its lowest value.

bands.text: Gain 1 in a trait of your choice.
The rolled trait drops to its lowest value (not the skull); if it's already there, drop another trait to its lowest.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Mystic Slide
EVENT_CARDS.text: The floor falls from under you.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
If you’re in the basement, this event affects the next explorer to your left not in the basement. Discard this card if all of the explorers are in the basement.
Place the Slide token in this room, then attempt a Might roll to use the Slide.
- 5+ You control the Slide. Put yourself in any explored room on any floor below the Slide.
- 0-4 Draw tiles from the room stack until you draw a basement room. Place the room tile. ( If no basement rooms are in the stack, choose a basement room in play.) you fall to that room and take 1 die of physical damage. If it's not your turn, don't draw a card for that room. 
On later turns, any explorer can attempt this roll to use the slide.

bands.text: Move to any explored room on any floor below the Slide.
Draw room tiles until a basement room comes up, place it, fall there.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Image in the Mirror
EVENT_CARDS.text: An old mirror shows a frightened younger you. You scrawl a hopeful note on the glass and pass something through.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
If you have no item cards, this happens to the next explorer to your left who has one; if nobody has an item, discard this card.
Pick one of your item cards (not an omen), shuffle it back into the item stack, and gain 1 Knowledge.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Funeral
EVENT_CARDS.text: A coffin lies open in front of you, and the body inside is yours.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Sanity.
4+: The vision fades. Gain 1 Sanity.
2-3: It shakes you. Lose 1 Sanity.
0-1: You really are in the coffin. Lose 1 Sanity and 1 Might clawing your way out. If the Graveyard or Crypt is in the house, move to one of them (your pick).

EVENT_CARDS.title: Night View
EVENT_CARDS.text: Two pale figures in wedding clothes drift silently across the grounds.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Knowledge.
5+: You know who they were, and they share the house's secrets. Gain 1 Knowledge.
0-4: You look away, shaken.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Groundskeeper
EVENT_CARDS.text: A man in work clothes rushes you with a raised shovel, then vanishes, leaving only muddy footprints.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Knowledge (an explorer in the Gardens rolls 2 fewer dice).
4+: Something is buried in the mud. Draw an item card.
0-3: He swings the shovel. The player to your right rolls a Might 4 attack against you; defend with Might as usual.

bands.text: Defend against a Might 4 attack (rolled by the player to your right).

EVENT_CARDS.title: Something Slimy
EVENT_CARDS.text: Something cold and wet wraps around your ankle.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Speed.
4+: You pull free. Gain 1 Speed.
1-3: Lose 1 Might.
0: Lose 1 Might and 1 Speed.

EVENT_CARDS.title: The Walls
EVENT_CARDS.text: The warm walls throb like a heartbeat and pull you through to somewhere else.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Draw the next room tile, place it in the house, and move your explorer into it.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Bloody Vision
EVENT_CARDS.text: Blood streams down the walls and pools around your shoes, then it's gone in a blink.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Sanity.
4+: You hold steady. Gain 1 Sanity.
2-3: Lose 1 Sanity.
0-1: If an explorer or monster is in your room or an adjacent one, you must attack it if you can, choosing the explorer with the lowest Might where possible.

bands.text: Attack an explorer or monster in your room or next door if you can (lowest-Might explorer first).

EVENT_CARDS.title: Creepy Crawlies
EVENT_CARDS.text: Countless insects swarm over your skin, under your clothes and into your hair.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Sanity.
5+: They vanish. Gain 1 Sanity.
1-4: Lose 1 Sanity.
0: Lose 2 Sanity.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Image in the Mirror
EVENT_CARDS.text: In an old mirror, a version of you from another time leaves a note on the glass and passes you something.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Draw an item card.

EVENT_CARDS.title: A Moment of Hope
EVENT_CARDS.text: This room feels oddly safe, as if something here pushes back against the house.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Place the Blessing token in this room. While in this room, each hero rolls 1 extra die (up to 8) on trait rolls.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Hanged Men
EVENT_CARDS.text: Three hanged figures sway in a cold draft, stare at you, then crumble to dust. Your throat tightens.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Make a roll for each of your four traits.
2+: That trait is fine.
0-1: Lose 1 from that trait.
If all four rolls are 2+, gain 1 in a trait of your choice.

bands.text: Lose 1 from the trait you rolled.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Drip... Drip... Drip...
EVENT_CARDS.text: A steady dripping sound starts grinding on your nerves.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Place the Drip token in this room. While in this room, each explorer rolls 1 fewer die (at least 1) on trait rolls.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Locked Safe
EVENT_CARDS.text: A wall safe hides behind a painting. It's surely booby-trapped.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Place the Safe token in this room. Once during their turn, an explorer here can roll Knowledge to open it.
5+: Draw 2 item cards and remove the Safe token.
2-4: Take 1 die of physical damage; it stays shut.
0-1: Take 2 dice of physical damage; it stays shut.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Skeletons
EVENT_CARDS.text: Two skeletons, a parent and a child, still holding each other.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Place the Skeletons token in this room and take 1 die of mental damage. Once during their turn, an explorer here can roll Sanity to search them.
5+: Draw an item card and remove the Skeletons token.
0-4: Nothing found. Take 1 die of mental damage.
Results only affect the explorer who rolled.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Debris
EVENT_CARDS.text: Chunks of plaster rain down from the walls and ceiling.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Speed.
3+: You dodge it. Gain 1 Speed.
1-2: You're buried. Take 1 die of physical damage.
0: You're buried. Take 2 dice of physical damage.
If buried, keep this card: you can't do anything until freed. Once during their turn, any explorer (you too) can roll Might to dig you out; 4+ frees you. After 3 failed tries you get free automatically on your next turn and play it normally. Discard this card when you're free.

EVENT_CARDS.title: The Beckoning
EVENT_CARDS.text: A voice in your head insists you get outside, leap, and fly free.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Each explorer in the Gardens, Graveyard, Tower, on the Balcony, or in a room with an outside-facing window rolls Sanity.
3+: You step back from the edge.
0-2: You jump to the Patio (if it isn't placed, find it in the room stack, place it, and reshuffle). Move there and take 1 die of physical damage.
Results only affect the explorer who rolled.

bands.text: Move to the Patio (place it from the room stack if needed).

EVENT_CARDS.title: Rotten
EVENT_CARDS.text: The room reeks of blood and death, like a slaughterhouse.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Sanity.
5+: Just a bad smell. Gain 1 Sanity.
2-4: Lose 1 Might.
1: Lose 1 Might and 1 Speed.
0: You're sick to your stomach. Lose 1 Might, 1 Speed, 1 Knowledge and 1 Sanity.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Secret Passage
EVENT_CARDS.text: Part of the wall slides back, revealing a damp, musty tunnel.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Place a Secret Passage token in this room. Roll 3 dice to place the second token:
6: any placed room.
4-5: any placed upper-floor room.
2-3: any placed ground-floor room.
0-1: any placed basement room.
You may use the passage right away, even with no movement left. Going from one Secret Passage token to the other counts as 1 space (the passage itself isn't a space). On later turns any explorer can use it, but nobody can end their turn inside it.

bands.text: Place the second token in any placed room.
Place the second token in a placed upper-floor room.
Place the second token in a placed ground-floor room.
Place the second token in a placed basement room.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Revolving Wall
EVENT_CARDS.text: The wall swings around and carries you somewhere else.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Place the Wall Switch token on a wall of this room that has no exit (or in a corner). If no room is on the other side, draw room tiles until one for this floor comes up and place it there (if this floor has no rooms left, discard this card). Then move into that room.
Once during their turn, an explorer in either room can roll Knowledge to use the Wall Switch.
3+: They find the switch and go through; this doesn't count as moving a space.
0-2: They can't find it and can't go through.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Grave Dirt
EVENT_CARDS.text: Thick dirt coats this room and works its way into your lungs.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Might.
4+: You shake it off. Gain 1 Might.
0-3: Something's wrong. Keep this card and take 1 point of physical damage at the start of each of your turns. Discard it if an item card raises one of your traits, or you end your turn in the Balcony, Gardens, Graveyard, Gymnasium, Larder, Patio or Tower.

bands.text: Keep this card: take 1 point of physical damage at the start of each of your turns.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Spider
EVENT_CARDS.text: A spider as big as your fist drops onto your shoulder and creeps into your hair.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Speed to swat it or Sanity to hold still.
4+: It's gone. Gain 1 in the trait you rolled.
1-3: It bites. Take 1 die of physical damage.
0: It takes a bite out of you. Take 2 dice of physical damage.

bands.text: Gain 1 in the trait you rolled.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Hideous Shriek
EVENT_CARDS.text: A whisper swells into a scream that tears at your soul.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Each explorer rolls Sanity.
4+: You block it out.
1-3: Take 1 die of mental damage.
0: Take 2 dice of mental damage.
Results only affect the explorer who rolled.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Closet Door
EVENT_CARDS.text: A closet door stands open a crack. Something must be in there.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Place the Closet token in this room. Once during their turn, an explorer here can roll 2 dice to open it.
4: Draw an item card.
2-3: Draw an event card.
0-1: Draw an event card and remove the Closet token.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Smoke
EVENT_CARDS.text: Thick smoke fills the room and stings your eyes.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Place the Smoke token in this room. It blocks line of sight from adjacent rooms. While in this room, an explorer rolls 2 fewer dice (at least 1) on trait rolls.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Whoops!
EVENT_CARDS.text: You trip over something body-shaped in the dark. Giggling footsteps run off.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Turn your item cards (not omens) face down and shuffle them. The player to your right picks one at random and discards it. Turn the rest face up again.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Secret Stairs
EVENT_CARDS.text: A long, ugly creak reveals a hidden stairway.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Place a Secret Stairs token in this room and another in a placed room on a different floor. Going from one token to the other counts as 1 space (the stairs aren't a space). You may take the stairs right now, even with no movement left; if you do, draw an event card in the room you arrive in.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Disquieting Sounds
EVENT_CARDS.text: A baby crying, a scream, glass shattering, then nothing.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Roll 6 dice. If the total is at least the number of omens revealed so far, gain 1 Sanity. Otherwise take 1 die of mental damage.

EVENT_CARDS.title: The Lost One
EVENT_CARDS.text: A woman in an old-fashioned gown waves you closer, and your mind goes foggy.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Knowledge. On 5+ you snap out of it and gain 1 Knowledge. Otherwise roll 3 dice to see where she leads you:
6: Move to the Entrance Hall.
4-5: Move to the Upper Landing.
2-3: Draw room tiles until an upper-floor room comes up.
0-1: Draw room tiles until a basement room comes up.
If you draw a room for a floor, place it and move there. If the stack runs out first, move to the Entrance Hall instead.

bands.text: Roll 3 dice: 6 Entrance Hall, 4-5 Upper Landing, 2-3 new upper-floor room, 0-1 new basement room.

EVENT_CARDS.title: What the...?
EVENT_CARDS.text: You look back and the room you came through is gone. Only fog remains.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: Lift the tile of the room you're in (set aside what's on it) and attach it elsewhere on the same floor so its door meets a different unexplored doorway, then put everything back. If this floor has no unexplored doorway, move the room to another floor.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Footsteps
EVENT_CARDS.text: Footprints form in the dust, walking toward you, then stop.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll 1 die (an explorer in the Chapel rolls 1 extra die).
4: You and the nearest explorer each gain 1 Might.
3: You gain 1 Might; the nearest explorer loses 1 Sanity.
2: Lose 1 Sanity.
1: Lose 1 Speed.
0: Every explorer loses 1 from a trait of their choice.

bands.text: Every explorer loses 1 from a trait of their choice.

EVENT_CARDS.title: The Voice
EVENT_CARDS.text: A whisper from under the floorboards asks you to dig, then goes quiet.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Knowledge.
4+: You find something under the floor. Draw an item card.
0-3: You search, but find nothing.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Shrieking Wind
EVENT_CARDS.text: The wind rises into a screaming howl.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Each explorer in the Gardens, Graveyard, Patio, Tower, on the Balcony, or in a room with an outside-facing window rolls Might.
5+: You stay on your feet.
3-4: Knocked down. Take 1 die of physical damage.
1-2: Chilled to the bone. Take 1 die of mental damage.
0: Knocked down hard. Take 1 die of physical damage and move one of your items (if any) to the Entrance Hall.
Results only affect the explorer who rolled.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Something Hidden
EVENT_CARDS.text: Something about this room bothers you, but you can't place it.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
You may roll Knowledge to work it out.
4+: A panel slides open on a hidden nook. Draw an item card.
0-3: It drives you a little mad. Lose 1 Sanity.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Burning Man
EVENT_CARDS.text: A man in flames sprints past; his skull bounces across the floor and vanishes.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Sanity.
4+: A bit warm, but fine. Gain 1 Sanity.
2-3: You have to get out. Move to the Entrance Hall.
0-1: You catch fire. Take 1 die of physical damage, then 1 die of mental damage as you put it out.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Angry Being
EVENT_CARDS.text: Something crawls out of the slime on the wall beside you.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Speed.
5+: You get away. Gain 1 Speed.
2-4: Take 1 die of mental damage.
0-1: Take 1 die of mental damage and 1 die of physical damage.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Phone Call
EVENT_CARDS.text: A phone rings. You can't stop yourself from answering, and a sweet old voice speaks.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll 2 dice.
4: She's delighted to hear from you. Gain 1 Sanity.
3: She says she's always watching over you. Gain 1 Knowledge.
1-2: She wants a kiss. Take 1 die of mental damage.
0: She says naughty children get punished. Take 2 dice of physical damage.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Jonah's Turn
EVENT_CARDS.text: Two boys fight over a spinning top. One won't share, it turns violent, and both fade away.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: If an explorer has the Puzzle Box, they discard it and draw a replacement item. If that happens, you gain 1 Sanity; if not, take 1 die of mental damage.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Silence
EVENT_CARDS.text: Down here every sound stops, even your own breath.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Each explorer in the basement rolls Sanity.
4+: You wait calmly for your hearing to return.
1-3: You scream without sound. Take 1 die of mental damage.
0: You panic. Take 2 dice of mental damage.
Results only affect the explorer who rolled.

EVENT_CARDS.title: Mists from the Walls
EVENT_CARDS.text: Fog seeps out of the walls, full of faces, some of them not human.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Each explorer in the basement rolls Sanity.
4+: Just tricks of the light.
1-3: Take 1 die of mental damage (1 extra die if you're in a room with an event symbol).
0: Take 1 die of mental damage (2 extra dice if you're in a room with an event symbol).
Results only affect the explorer who rolled.

bands.text: Take 1 die of mental damage (+1 die in an event-symbol room).
Take 1 die of mental damage (+2 dice in an event-symbol room).

EVENT_CARDS.title: Creepy Puppet
EVENT_CARDS.text: One of those unsettling dolls leaps at you with a tiny spear.
EVENT_CARDS.rules: The player to your right rolls a Might 4 attack against you for the Creepy Puppet; defend with Might as usual. If you take any damage, the explorer holding the Spear gains 2 Might (unless that's you).

EVENT_CARDS.title: Webs
EVENT_CARDS.text: You go to brush some cobwebs aside, but they cling and won't let go.
EVENT_CARDS.rules:
Roll Might.
4+: You tear free. Gain 1 Might and discard this card.
0-3: You're stuck. Keep this card.
While stuck you can't do anything until freed. Once during their turn, any explorer (you too) can roll Might to free you; 4+ works but doesn't give the 1 Might. Anyone who fails can't move for the rest of that turn. After 3 failed tries you get free automatically on your next turn and play it normally. Discard this card when you're free.

bands.text: You're stuck and can't act until freed.

OMEN_CARDS.title: Skull
OMEN_CARDS.text: A Skull, cracked and missing teeth
OMEN_CARDS.rules: If you take mental damage, you can take all of it as physical damage instead.

OMEN_CARDS.title: Bite
OMEN_CARDS.text: A growl, the scent of death. Pain. Darkness. Gone.
OMEN_CARDS.rules: When you draw this card, something bites you: it makes a Might 4 attack against you. Defend by rolling dice equal to your Might as normal. This omen can't be dropped, traded or stolen.

OMEN_CARDS.title: Crystal Ball
OMEN_CARDS.text: Hazy images appear in the glass.
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Once during your turn after the haunt is revealed, you can attempt a Knowledge roll to peer into the Crystal Ball.

bands.text: You see the truth. Search the item or event stack for a card of your choice. Shuffle that stack, then place that card on top.
You avert your eyes. Lose 1 Sanity.
You stare into Hell. Lose 2 Sanity.

OMEN_CARDS.title: Spear
OMEN_CARDS.rules: You roll 2 additional dice(maximum of 8 dice) when making a Might attact with this weapon. You can't use another weapon while you're using this one

OMEN_CARDS.title: Girl
OMEN_CARDS.text: A girl. Trapped. Alone. You free her!
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Gain 1 Sanity and 1 Knowledge now. Lose 1 Sanity and 1 Knowledge if you lose custody of the girl. This omen can't be dropped, traded or stolen

OMEN_CARDS.title: Holy Symbol
OMEN_CARDS.text: A symbol of calm in an unsettling world
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Gain 2 Sanity now. Lose 2 Sanity if you lose the Holy Symbol

OMEN_CARDS.title: Madman
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Gain 2 Might and lose 1 Sanity now. Lose 2 Might and gain 1 Sanity if you lose custody of the Madman. This omen can't be dropped, traded or stolen

OMEN_CARDS.title: Dog
OMEN_CARDS.text: This mangy dog seems friendly. At least you hope it is
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Gain 1 Might and 1 Sanity now. Lose 1 Might and 1 Sanity if you lose custody of the dog. Take a small monster token to represent the Dog. Put it in your room. (Use a token of a different color from other monster, if any.) Once during your turn, the Dog can move to any explored room up to 6 spaces away, using doors and stairs, and then return. It can pick up, carry, and/or drop 1 item before it returns. The Dog isn't slowed by opponents. It can't use one-way passages or rooms that require a roll. It can't carry items that slow movement. This omen can't be dropped, traded or stolen.

OMEN_CARDS.title: Ring
OMEN_CARDS.text: A battered ring with an incomprehensible inscription.
OMEN_CARDS.rules: If You attact an opppnent that has a Sanity trait, you can attact with Sanity instead of Might. (your oppenent then defends with Sanity, and damage is mental instead of physical.)

OMEN_CARDS.title: Book
OMEN_CARDS.text: A diary or lab notes? Ancient script or modern ravings?
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Gain 2 Knowledge now. Lose 2 Knowledge if you lose the Book.

OMEN_CARDS.title: Medallion
OMEN_CARDS.text: A medallion inscribed with a pentagram.
OMEN_CARDS.rules: You are immune to the effects of the Pentagram Chamber, Crypt, and Graveyard

OMEN_CARDS.title: Mask
OMEN_CARDS.text: A somber mask to hide intentions.
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Once during your turn, you can attempt a Sanity roll to use the Mask

bands.text: You can put on or take off the Mask. Put it on: gain 2 Knowledge and lose 2 Sanity. Take it off: gain 2 Sanity and lose 2 Knowledge.
You can't use the Mask this turn.

OMEN_CARDS.title: Spirit Board
OMEN_CARDS.text: A board with letters and numbers to call the dead
OMEN_CARDS.rules: Before you move during your turn, you can look at the top tile of the room stack. If you use the Spirit Board after the haint has been revealed, the traitor can move any number of monsters 1 space closer to you. (if you are the traitor, you don't have to move those monsters.) If there is no traitor, all monster move 1 space closer to you.
